name: Song Format Validation
description: Validate v6 song package structure and songwriting quality

then.prompt: Follow core/methodology/suno-optimization.md current v6 workflow and templates/suno-v6-song.md. Validate multiple distinct Style prompts and Intro Concepts before lock, Vocal Identity reuse, Intro Differentiation Gate comparing first 15–20 seconds against up to three prior tracks (or explicit history limitation), valid production selection, Advanced Options, Changes and Next Changes. Retain checks for title, Production/Vocal Direction, isolated section tags and complete Production Notes (key, BPM, meter, Nashville + actual chords, vocal, instruments, dynamics, hook, rhyme, emotional arc). Count each Style separately and only the Lyrics payload. Use tools/validate-song.py if execution is available. Human review must assess meaningful intro contrast, prosody, breath, hook and singer continuity; structural PASS is not an audio guarantee. Use --legacy only for explicitly historical single-prompt files.
